title: Context Engineer
summary: Designs what goes into a model's context: retrieval, memory, tool results and instructions, under a token budget.
whatYouDo: Decide what information a model sees, in what order and format
Build retrieval, memory and summarisation that fit a token budget
Measure how context changes answer quality, cost and latency

stages.title: Foundations
stages.goal: Code comfortably and understand how models read context.
stages.project: A script that counts tokens and trims a long document to fit a budget

stages.title: Context anatomy
stages.goal: Design system prompts, instructions and examples that models follow reliably.

resources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents (Anthropic)

stages.project: Rewrite one messy prompt into a clear, tested context template

stages.title: Retrieval
stages.goal: Fetch only the information that helps the answer.
stages.project: A retrieval pipeline that beats naive chunking on 20 test questions

stages.title: Memory & tools
stages.goal: Keep long-running agents on track without overflowing context.
stages.project: An assistant that stays accurate across a 50-turn conversation

stages.title: Evaluation
stages.goal: Prove a context change made things better, not just different.
stages.project: An eval suite that scores three context strategies side by side

stages.title: Professional
stages.goal: Ship context systems teams can maintain.
stages.project: A write-up of a context system with its eval results
